query: I need a premium deep orange soy candle in a ceramic vessel for a client.

products.title: Moroccan Terracotta Soy Candle
products.description: Handcrafted in Marrakesh, Morocco, this Moroccan Terracotta Soy Candle features a warm amber scent housed in a handmade glazed terracotta vessel. The natural soy wax creates a soothing atmosphere, and once the candle is burned through, the rustic cup can be repurposed as a decorative accent, a small storage container, or a coffee cup.
key_features: Handmade glazed terracotta cup crafted by artisans in Marrakesh, Morocco
Natural soy wax blended with a rich amber fragrance
Reusable vessel can be repurposed for coffee, storage, or home decor

products.title: Ceramic Golden Moments Jar Candle
products.description: This 6oz soy wax candle is designed to capture snapshots in time inspired by nature. The candle vessel is made of ceramic and is designed to be repurposed as a planter once the candle has burned down. The product includes seeds for aromatic plants to continue its life beyond the flame.

products.title: Moroccan Terracotta Soy Candle
products.description: A handmade terracotta glazed candle vessel from Morocco houses amber scented soy wax. Crafted in Marrakesh, each cup features hand-glazed finishes with a cream and terracotta color block. The candle offers a warm amber aroma, and once burned, the ceramic cup can be repurposed as a decorative piece or small storage. Specifications include a compact size and weight, with care instructions noting hand-washing due to terracotta’s porous nature and minor glaze cracking that may occur from artisanal production.

products.title: Apothecary 18 Ceramic Jar Candle
products.description: A beautifully crafted ceramic jar candle with a lid, featuring a warm and inviting 'Spice Orchard Woods' fragrance. Inspired by French apothecary jars, this candle offers a sophisticated scent profile with notes of woodland acorns, orchard apples, cardamom, and clove, all housed in an elegant ceramic vessel. It provides a long-lasting burn time of approximately 65 hours, making it a perfect addition to any home decor or a thoughtful gift.

products.title: Cranberry Orange Soy Candle
products.description: A hand-poured soy candle with a quintessential seasonal scent featuring tart cranberry and zesty citrus balanced with warm spices. It is made from 100% U.S.-grown soybean wax with a cotton core wick, and is vegan, gluten-free, paraben-free, and phthalate-free.

products.title: Soy Wax Ceramic Candle
products.description: This luxurious 2-pack set features two soy wax candles in elegant, hand-glazed ceramic vessels. The collection includes 'Lilac Mist', an evocative floral scent blending jasmine and lilac with a sandalwood base, and 'Matcha Bloom', a bright citrus tea fragrance with notes of jasmine, matcha, and creamy white chocolate. Developed by master Swiss perfumers, these 100% vegan candles are designed to burn evenly without tunneling or residue for up to 40 hours. The reusable satin-matte ceramic containers are crafted to be timeless decor pieces for your space long after the candle has finished.
key_features: Scent developed by master Swiss perfumers
Hand-glazed ceramic vessel with satin-matte finish
Burns evenly without tunneling or residue
Burn time of up to 40 hours

products.title: Large Ceramic Candle

Due to its artisanal nature, each piece possesses subtle variations in glaze and finish.
key_features: Scent notes of vanilla, frankincense, patchouli, sandalwood, and palo santo
